name: Radisson Blu Waterfront Hotel
description: A premium waterfront hotel in central Stockholm with stunning harbour views. Just a short walk or boat ride from Gröna Lund with world-class amenities, multiple restaurants and easy access to all Stockholm attractions.

rooms.name: Standard Room
rooms.description: Modern room with harbour or city views, premium amenities and easy access to Gröna Lund.

rooms.name: Harbour Suite
rooms.description: Luxurious suite with panoramic Stockholm harbour views and premium hotel benefits.

name: STF af Chapman Hostel
description: A unique and iconic hostel aboard a historic tall ship moored in central Stockholm, just minutes from Gröna Lund. One of the most memorable places to stay in Stockholm with stunning views of the Old Town and Royal Palace.

rooms.name: Dorm Room
rooms.description: Affordable shared cabin aboard the historic ship with stunning Stockholm harbour views.

rooms.name: Private Cabin
rooms.description: Private cabin on the ship with Old Town views and a unique nautical atmosphere.

name: Lydmar Hotel
description: A stylish luxury boutique hotel on Strandvägen, one of Stockholm's most prestigious addresses. Features individually designed rooms, a popular restaurant and bar, and is within easy reach of Gröna Lund via tram or boat.

rooms.name: Classic Room
rooms.description: Individually designed room on prestigious Strandvägen with premium amenities and city views.

rooms.name: Superior Room
rooms.description: Spacious superior room with harbour views and access to the acclaimed Lydmar restaurant and bar.
